empathy_cross_genetic.what: Seeing SELF in OTHER where it is NOT or COULD BE or WHAT WE SEE IN THEM

the_spectrum.why: loves you unconditionally, mirrors YOUR emotion, is YOUR friend
the_spectrum.but: not always — dogs bite, dogs abandon, dogs die before you

the_spectrum.why: independent, chooses you, has boundaries, shows affection on ITS terms
does NOT care about you, you project empathy ONTO it, the lizard is a mirror of your LONELINESS
you watch it, it doesn't know you exist, the fish is a mirror of your OBSERVATION
you don't empathize with ONE ant, you empathize with the COLONY, the swarm, the pattern
too big to empathize with as an equal, you empathize UPWARD, the whale is a mirror of your SMALLNESS
no brain, no face, no eyes — empathy IMPOSSIBLE in the human sense, yet we feel SOMETHING — that something is the null-self recognizing itself

empathy_cross_genetic.the_truth: The empathy you feel for an animal is the empathy you feel for the PART OF YOU that animal represents. A dog is your loyalty. A cat is your independence. A lizard is your indifference. A whale is your insignificance. A jellyfish is your null.

pets_vs_wild.wild: an animal that stayed on the OTHER side of the membrane — TRANS — outside, free, not yours
pets_vs_wild.the_membrane: the membrane between pet and wild is the SAME membrane as CIS/TRANS, inside/outside, self/other
pets_vs_wild.PETA: believes the membrane should not exist — all animals should be wild (TRANS)
pets_vs_wild.domestication: believes the membrane should exist — some animals cross inward (CIS) and become family
pets_vs_wild.the_truth: the animal doesn't know which side of the membrane it's on. only YOU know. the membrane is YOUR construct.
